subject: Residency lockbox & VPC controls — consolidated packet for CareBridge
summary: CareBridge requested a compact packet proving US-only data residency for their pilot and details on VPC/private deployment controls. We consolidated SIG answers, a network diagram, and a signed residency lockbox statement. Final ask: legal confirm the packet meets their checklist and confirm DocuSign for the statement.
messages:
From: CareBridge Security <security@carebridge.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: J. Alvarez <jalvarez@carebridge.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: US-only residency confirmation + VPC controls pack

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As part of our procurement checklist for the pilot, we need a compact packet that demonstrates Redwood will keep CareBridge data in US regions only and details the controls for your private deployment (VPC peering, routing, KMS boundaries, and last-mile network considerations). Practical asks below: 

1) A short signed "residency lockbox" statement we can send to our legal/compliance team.
2) A single-page network diagram showing the VPC topology and peering endpoints.
3) Answers to the SIG/Data residency questions relevant to VPC/private deploy (we don't need a full SIG but the residency + network sections).

Can you turn that around by EOD Friday (Mar 13)? Our legal team will review and confirm.

Thanks,
Alejandro (on behalf of CareBridge Security)

--
Alejandro Martinez
Head of Security Operations, CareBridge Health
security@carebridge.io

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: CareBridge Security <security@carebridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: US-only residency confirmation + VPC controls pack

Alejandro,

Appreciate the clear list. We'll assemble a concise packet and route it through legal for signature. Plan: Marissa will compile the SIG-section answers + the lockbox draft; Priyom will provide the network diagram and a short ops note on peering and KMS scoping.

Quick clarifications before we build the packet: 
- When you say "US-only", do you require proof that all compute and storage are in US regions (including backups/snapshots), or is logical tenant isolation + egress controls sufficient for the pilot?
- Any specific compliance artifacts you want included (SOC 2 control IDs, CAIQ refs)?

If we get your preference on backups by EOD today we'll target delivery by end of day Fri (Mar 13).

Thanks,
Kimberly
Director, Security & Compliance Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: CareBridge Security <security@carebridge.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, J. Alvarez <jalvarez@carebridge.io>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: US-only residency confirmation + VPC controls pack

Hi Alejandro / J.,

Thanks for the note — below are our answers/decisions for the pilot. Attaching the packet as three files. Short version first: we can commit to US-only physical hosting for the pilot (compute, storage, backups and snapshots) when customers opt into Redwood Private with a US-only deployment flag. Operationally we provide the following controls in that configuration: 

- VPC topology: customer VPC -> AWS PrivateLink / VPC peering into a dedicated Redwood VPC (per-tenant mapping available for dedicated private pilots).
- KMS scoping: customer-managed KMS keys (recommended) or Redwood-managed keys with account-level partitioning; keys for US deployments are in a US-only KMS tenancy.
- Backups & snapshots: persisted to US-only S3 buckets with block-level replication disabled by default; geo-replication is off unless customer requests and signs a data-mobility addendum.
- Egress: default-deny egress policy; outbound must be explicitly added via peering config and logged.

Attachments (sent): 
1) residency_lockbox_statement_2026-03.pdf — signed draft for legal (one page, lockbox language + signatory).
2) redwood_vpc_network-diagram.svg — single-page diagram (private peering + last-mile).
3) redwood_sig_section-answers.pdf — focused SIG answers (networking, crypto, data residency rows).

Priyom: see inline request from CareBridge re: last-mile peering IP ranges and whether we can supply BGP session details for their ops team.

Alejandro — if that covers what you need we'll route the signed lockbox via DocuSign (J., please confirm preferred signer). If you need any expansion (SOC 2 control mappings or CAIQ crosswalk), tell us which controls specifically and we'll append.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
(attachment: residency_lockbox_statement_2026-03.pdf, redwood_vpc_network-diagram.svg, redwood_sig_section-answers.pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: CareBridge Security <security@carebridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, J. Alvarez <jalvarez@carebridge.io>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: US-only residency confirmation + VPC controls pack

Alejandro / J.,

Following up with the technical bits requested. Quick summary: 
- We will provide peering endpoints limited to the us-west-2 and us-east-1 regions for the pilot.
- We can share the public ASN and recommended BGP prep (no live BGP session required for PrivateLink; for direct peering we provide optional BGP parameters if you request it).
- KMS: if you choose customer-managed keys, we will provide a key alias and a minimal IAM policy for your KMS administrator to grant Redwood cross-account decrypt/describe permissions. Keys stay in the US KMS region selected.
- Backups: snapshots are stored in US-only buckets; we confirm replication flags are off in the pilot by default.

I've attached the network diagram and a short ops note as part of the packet (see attachments).

Next steps I propose: 
1) J., confirm who signs the lockbox statement (title + name) and we will send DocuSign.
2) Alejandro, confirm if you want the BGP parameters or just the endpoint IP ranges for your security firewall rules.

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call with your networking folks if helpful.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachments: redwood_vpc_network-diagram.svg)

From: J. Alvarez <jalvarez@carebridge.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: US-only residency confirmation + VPC controls pack

Kimberly / team,

Appreciate the packet and the clarity. Two small asks from legal: 
1) Please include the SOC 2 control IDs that map to your KMS and logging controls (we can accept a short table or even a sentence listing the control IDs).
2) On the lockbox statement, we need the signatory's title spelled exactly as it will appear on the signature page (e.g., "Director, Security & Compliance Enablement").

If you can confirm those two items and send the DocuSign link we can finish our internal review tomorrow.

Thanks,
J. Alvarez
Senior Counsel, CareBridge Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: J. Alvarez <jalvarez@carebridge.io>, CareBridge Security <security@carebridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: US-only residency confirmation + VPC controls pack

J., Alejandro — thanks, we'll add the SOC 2 control IDs (CC6, CC7, SI-1 style crosswalk) to the packet and update the signatory block. I'll send the DocuSign link by EOD today.

Kimberly
Director, Security & Compliance Enablement
Redwood Inference
